## Introduction 

In this course we covered Sequential and Binary search. This page includes practice problems to help you prepare for you exam and internalize each search algorithm. 

## How To Use This Page

For each problem, use the **↻ New variant** button to generate a new problem of that type. Use the **Check** button to check your answer. Use the **Show answer** button to see the answer an and an explanation.
